Subjects.Subject: Urgent reminder: Social Media Minimum Age data linkage form

BodyHtmls.BodyHtml:
Dear ^first_name^,

I’m writing to follow up about linking ^child_nickname^’s survey answers for the Social Media Minimum Age evaluation to information about them from NAPLAN and/or Medicare Benefits Schedule and Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme.

You said in the survey that you would be willing to do this. We then sent you a link to a form to fill out to allow this to happen. It does not look like you have completed the form. As a thank you for your time completing the form, we will give you a $5 reward once you complete it.

To complete the form, please click the button below:

Complete Form

If you have changed your mind, you can use the unsubscribe link to let us know so that we do not send any more reminders.

Thanks,
Kipling Zubevich
Chief Executive Officer
Social Research Centre

To not receive any further emails from us regarding this survey, please click here. To opt-out from all future Life in Australia™ surveys, please call 1800 023 040. Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Privacy Policy.
